mapper.sql: ea.area_id as "areaId", ea.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", ea.area_code as "areaCode", ea.area_name as "areaName", ea.sort_order as "sortOrder", ea.active_yn as "activeYn", ea.period_apply_method as "periodApplyMethod", ea.change_reason as "changeReason", ea.updated_by as "updatedBy", ea.updated_at as "updatedAt"

where.if: and (ea.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select from evaluation_areas ea inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ea.rule_version_id
order by ea.sort_order, ea.area_code limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select count(*) from evaluation_areas ea inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ea.rule_version_id
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_areas (rule_version_id, area_code, area_name, sort_order, active_yn, period_apply_method, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.ruleVersionId}, #{request.areaCode}, #{request.areaName}, #{request.sortOrder}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.periodApplyMethod}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (rule_version_id, area_code) do update set area_name = EXCLUDED.area_name, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, period_apply_method = EXCLUDED.period_apply_method, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
